responsibility: This header defines the NetBSD-specific AArch64 subtarget settings, specializing the generic ELF port for NetBSD toolchain and runtime conventions. It selects linker emulations for both endian variants, builds the NetBSD LINK_SPEC and CPP spec, provides NetBSD OS builtins and extra specs such as asm_cpu_spec, and folds in the common AArch64 erratum linker options so that NetBSD AArch64 builds use the correct driver and linker behavior.
